_comment: Non-gameplay scene tokens (lobby / menu / intermission). Used by engines/reaction/scene.py to LABEL clips that fired on social hype with no gameplay behind them (e.g. pregame lobby banter), so the review UI can tag + filter them instead of calling them gameplay reactions. Matching is whole-word/phrase, case-insensitive. Keep tokens strong and menu-only to avoid mislabeling real gameplay. 'intermission' tokens are stream-frame text (starting soon / BRB); 'lobby' tokens are in-game menus. Safe to extend per-game without code changes.
